meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – English common law, French civil law, and customary law
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty is currently in force with Vanuatu
No double taxation agreement is currently in force (Vanuatu applies zero corporate income tax)
Vanuatu is a party to the PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) trade agreement
Tax Information Exchange Agreements are in force with Australia and New Zealand

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 77] (as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 6 of 2014; Companies (Amendment) Act 2017 (beneficial ownership filing requirements); VFSC AML/CFT Rule 1/2019

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association (notarized copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu licensed notary public / Commissioner for Oaths

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and Consent to Act as Registered Agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and registered agents against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU and UK HM Treasury sanctions lists, and VFSC disqualified/banned list. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) must be identified for all UBOs, with documented source of wealth and source of funds declarations. Ongoing transaction monitoring and enhanced due diligence apply under the AML/CFT Act No. 6 of 2014 and VFSC AML Rule 1/2019.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: VFSC Company Registration and Online Search Portal (https://register.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be distinguishable from existing registered names and must not be misleading or contrary to public policy. Names may be in English or French; non-Latin alphabet names require transliteration into Latin script for the VFSC register. The proposed name must include a standard suffix indicating limited liability, such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', or 'Corporation', in compliance with the International Companies Act.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Registry within 21 days of the rejection notice, stating the legal grounds and any proposed name modifications. The VFSC Registry must issue a written decision within 14 business days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may escalate to the Vanuatu Companies Appeals Board or seek judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within the applicable limitation period.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this EMR SaaS entity because no physical clinic or local operational premises are required. A registered office address in Vanuatu must be maintained through a VFSC-licensed registered agent and must be accessible for official correspondence and process service. A virtual office satisfies the registered office obligation only when coupled with the licensed agent's physical address and 24/7 service capacity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 5% annual probability for a low-risk, zero-tax International Company engaging in software-only EMR/SaaS activities; this reflects routine VFSC AML inspection programs rather than sector-specific on-site audits.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [CAP 222], as amended, including the provisions governing incorporation, registered office, share capital, directors, and the licensed registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation of an International Company, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow account is required. Authorized share capital may be denominated in any currency, and shares may be issued at par, at a premium, or as no-par-value shares.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Memorandum and Articles of Association of Vanuatu International Company VU_IC (the Company), as registered with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, are hereby ratified and adopted. RESOLVED that the Company accepts the subscription for 100 ordinary shares of no par value by the founding subscriber, and that such shares are issued fully paid against consideration previously contributed. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the principal office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu. RESOLVED that [Chief Executive Officer] be appointed Chief Executive Officer, [Chief Financial Officer] Chief Financial Officer, and [Company Secretary] Company Secretary, each to serve until successor appointment or earlier removal by resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Corporate Structure Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Registry through a licensed Vanuatu registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to conduct a name search and submit a name reservation request to the VFSC electronic registry. Confirm the proposed corporate name includes an acceptable suffix such as Limited or Ltd, and verify that the name is not undesirable or identical to an existing registered company.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and suffix
Notarized passport copy of each subscriber and director
Letter of engagement with the licensed registered agent
Preliminary beneficial ownership information declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as undesirable or too similar, submit an alternative name reservation request through the same registered agent, or file an administrative objection with the VFSC within 14 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent acting as the statutory applicant before VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act. Set the authorized share capital, class of shares, registered office address, director provisions, and subscriber details. Ensure that all subscribers and proposed directors execute the constitutional documents before a notary or authorized witness.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as director signed by each proposed director
Consent of subscriber to take shares
Consent of the licensed registered agent to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC raises a query on execution, signature witnessing, or share allotment language, cure by filing a corrected execution page or a notarized rectification statement within 10 business days of the query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC, Registry of International Companies, Port Vila or online filing portal through the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, director consents, registered agent declaration, and beneficial ownership information. Pay the prescribed incorporation and filing fees to the VFSC or to the authorized collection account and retain the official receipt.
required_dossiers: Completed and signed Form IC-1
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Signed consents of directors and registered agent
Government filing fee payment receipt
Beneficial ownership declaration in the required VFSC format
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for incomplete data or missing wet-ink signatures, submit the specific outstanding document and a written corrective confirmation within 10 business days. If the query disputes the registered agent declaration, obtain a fresh declaration from the licensed agent and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of Certificate of Incorporation and Establishment of Statutory Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC and the Company's licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC issues a Certificate of Incorporation for the International Company. The registered agent then establishes the statutory registers, including the register of members, directors, and charges, and records the issued shares and the registered office address in the VFSC system.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
Register of members and share allotments
Register of directors and officers
Notice of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains a typographical or legal name discrepancy, submit a written request to VFSC for rectification together with the original certificate and a supporting declaration from the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Passing of First Board Resolution and Establishment of Corporate Governance Pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Company Secretary of VU_IC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass a written resolution in lieu of a meeting approving the issue of shares to the founding subscriber, adopting the registered office, and appointing the executive officers and secretary. Maintain signed minutes, share certificates, and the corporate governance binder at the registered office or registered agent premises.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting or written board resolution
Share certificate issued to the founding subscriber
Officer and director acceptance forms
Certified copy of the registered office address confirmation
Register of directors and officers updated
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the board resolution is later found not to comply with the constitutional documents, cure by passing a ratifying ordinary resolution and filing an amended resolution with the registered agent and VFSC.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA), in coordination with the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue for business licence fee administration, under the Business Licence Act [CAP 249]
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Vanuatu Business Licence for Information Technology and Software Services (Electronic Medical Record Software as a Service), together with a Foreign Investment Certificate if the company is foreign-controlled

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Government of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration and preliminary environmental assessment only; no full Environmental Impact Assessment report is required for cloud-based EMR software operations conducted in an ordinary commercial office or leased data-center space, unless standby diesel generators, physical industrial infrastructure, or significant waste streams are introduced.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater, volatile organic compound, or major point-source emissions are anticipated. The operator must comply with the Vanuatu Environment Protection and Conservation Act, maintain waste electrical and electronic equipment handling in accordance with national waste regulations, and, if a standby generator is installed, comply with applicable DEPC air emissions limits and fuel-storage secondary-containment requirements.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance from the Vanuatu Police Fire Service for the leased office and any server or data-equipment room; electrical installation compliance certificate and structural load inspection from the municipal building authority; and occupational safety and health clearance from the Vanuatu Department of Labour covering workstation ergonomics, electrical safety, emergency evacuation, and first-aid readiness before clinical data processing operations commence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), established under the Revenue Administration Act No. 22 of 2017; national taxpayer portal: VRCA TAPS (Taxpayer Accounting and Processing System) at https://www.vanuatuvra.gov.vu/ operating a single national Taxpayer Identification Number regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity that will make taxable supplies in Vanuatu must apply for a single Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and VAT registration by lodging the prescribed application form with the VRCA Commissioner, together with certified copies of the certificate of incorporation or international company registration, memorandum and articles, directors' identification (passport and proof of address), registered-office or licensed-agent confirmation, and a written undertaking to maintain records. The application must be filed within 14 days after the entity becomes liable to register for VAT; the VRCA issues the TIN and the VAT registration certificate in accordance with its published service standards. An International Company carrying on no business in Vanuatu is exempt and is not required to obtain a TIN; however, an IC may voluntarily apply for VAT registration under section 9(3) of the VAT Act No. 12 of 1998 to issue zero-rated export invoices or recover input tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — non-resident International Company (International Companies Act, Cap 176) conducting wholly offshore business. Vanuatu imposes no income tax, corporate profits tax, capital gains tax, inheritance tax, or withholding tax on any taxpayer, so the IC classification is exemption-driven and territorial in effect; the IC remains outside the domestic VAT net unless it elects to carry on a taxable activity within Vanuatu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections exist under Vanuatu law because no income tax statute is in force. Available statutory elections: (1) an IC may apply to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Registrar to convert to or from domestic-company status under the International Companies Act; (2) an IC may elect voluntary VAT registration to recover input tax on acquisitions or to render VAT-compliant zero-rated export invoices; (3) an IC may elect to maintain its accounting records offshore without local audit, subject to the VRCA's statutory powers of access and record production.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT Act No. 12 of 1998, as consolidated and amended by the VAT (Amendment) Act 2023; standard rate 13% effective from 1 July 2023)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 10,000,000 of annual taxable turnover in any 12-month period (VUV 2,000,000 for a business whose supplies are principally manufacturing); voluntary registration permitted below threshold; exports of goods and services are zero-rated, and an offshore International Company without local taxable supplies has no registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: VRCA Electronic Time-Stamping System (ETSS): registered traders must use VRCA-certified invoicing or point-of-sale software that transmits each fiscal invoice to the VRCA in real time through an API interface, receives a digitally authenticated fiscal stamping token, and renders a coded invoice (QR or tamper-evident fiscal seal) before the supply is complete for VAT purposes. Monthly VAT returns (Form VAT-11) are lodged electronically through the TAPS portal, and payment is due no later than the 20th day of the month following the relevant taxable period; the ETSS mandate applies without turnover exemption to tourist-facing and other high-risk traders.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: 0% VAT applies under section 13(1)(a) of the VAT Act where the goods are exported out of Vanuatu and the supplier retains the customs export entry. Services: 0% applies under section 13(1)(b) where the services are supplied to a person outside Vanuatu and the benefit and use of the services occurs outside Vanuatu; offshore electronic medical record (EMR) software-as-a-service supplied by the IC to non-resident medical clinics qualifies as an exported service. Vanuatu has no exchange-control legislation; the 180-day inward-remittance window is applied as the compliance benchmark for evidenced foreign exchange repatriation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document, Form C1) certified by Vanuatu Customs at the port of exportation
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export of goods or, for pure e-services, a geo-IP server log and online service-delivery record of the subscription provided to the offshore clinic

Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a licensed Vanuatu bank or, for e-services, SWIFT or Stripe settlement evidence identifying the non-resident payer and matching the invoice amount within the 180-day repatriation window
Final 0% VAT invoice cross-referenced to the export contract, the customs entry, and the payment receipt, retained for the statutory six-year record-keeping period
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims expose the IC and its officers to retrospective VAT assessment at 13% of the value of the supply, a late-payment penalty of 25% of the tax evaded, and monthly arrears interest at 2%; knowingly false declarations and forged supporting documentation constitute criminal offenses under the VAT Act and the Revenue Administration Act No. 22 of 2017, punishable by monetary fines and terms of imprisonment; customs export fraud additionally triggers seizure and forfeiture of the goods, cancellation of the supplier's VAT registration, and clawback of any refunds historically paid for the prior six years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a fully convertible currency regime under IMF Article VIII obligations. There are no exchange control approvals required for capital account transactions, profit remittances, or trade-related settlements in VUV or foreign currencies. The Vatu is freely transferable within the Pacific regional settlement systems, and non-resident International Companies may maintain foreign currency accounts without permission. Remittance of dividends or repatriation of capital attributable to the EMR SaaS business is unrestricted, subject only to standard anti-money laundering and know-your-customer due diligence by the remitting bank. No statutory restriction applies to current account convertibility; all cross-border payments may be executed by commercial banks under the prevailing RBV and Financial Transactions Reporting Act compliance framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory timeline or mandatory conversion ratio exists under the Laws of Vanuatu for surrender of export proceeds. Export receipts derived from the licensed medical clinic EMR SaaS platform may be retained in foreign currency or converted to VUV at the discretion of the account holder. The RBV does not impose any mandatory forex repatriation, deposit, or conversion regime; the only applicable obligations are the anti-money laundering record-keeping requirements under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, which require the underlying cross-border transaction documentation, including purpose codes and client identification, to be preserved for at least five years.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Foreign Currency Escrow Account
Operational Account / VUV and USD Multi-Currency Account
Operational Account / Settlement Account for Government-linked Healthcare Contracts

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low to Medium. Vanuatu does not have a dedicated Electronic Money Institution licensing category under the Financial Dealers Act or the RBV Act. Foreign fintech EMIs and offshore digital payment providers are not permitted to directly hold client electronic money or conduct payment services without entering into a formal banking partnership or acquiring a local dealer/exchange licence under the Financial Dealers (Licensing and Control) Act. The most viable compliant structure is a sponsored account arrangement with a tier-1 domestic commercial bank acting as the settlement and treasury gateway, while the EMI operates solely as a non-settlement software front-end. However, the RBV has issued cautionary guidance on unlicensed cross-border EMIs, making their use for the EMR SaaS's recurring medical clinic billing and treasury flows legally inadvisable unless a local custodial banking arrangement is approved.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Vanuatu's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act and bank-specific AML policies require beneficial owners and authorised signatories of an International Company to undergo a full KYC interview. Remote opening via videoconference is generally not accepted by tier-1 commercial banks as the sole KYC measure. At least one natural person who is a director or senior officer of the EMR SaaS entity, holding a valid passport and proof of source-of-wealth documentation, must attend an in-person appointment at the bank's no-recall, or varuatu head office branch, or at a designated correspondent office abroad subject to notarisation. The board resolution authorising account opening must be original or apostilled. A Private Trust Company or nominee director arrangement may be accepted only if the ultimate beneficial owner provides a sworn source-of-funds declaration and attends the interview alongside the registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner opacity: use of nominee directors or trusts without a transparent declaration of natural persons behind the corporate structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate registry extracts including the Register of Beneficial Owners (filed under Vanuatu's Companies and International Companies Acts), a written chain-of-title analysis, signed declarations of trust or nominee arrangements, valid passports, proof of residential address, and a professional legal opinion letter identifying the natural person as the ultimate beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction nexus: counterparties, clients, or payment recipients located in jurisdictions referenced by the Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (Financial Actions Task Force) high-risk watchlists, or on Vanuatu's own approval list.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial rationale documentation for the EMR SaaS subscription revenue and medical equipment disbursements, independent economic-substance records, detailed end-use declarations, invoice and contract packets, SWIFT or correspondent-bank reimbursement references, and a compliance memorandum demonstrating that the transaction chain terminates in legitimate licensed medical clinics rather than shell entities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ambiguous source of funds or source of wealth for the initial capital injection, particularly without a corroborated 12-month bank statement trail.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original bank statements for the last 12 months from the funding bank, certified tax returns or income audits, sale and purchase agreements for any disposed assets, inheritance documentation, audited financial statements of the shareholder entity, and independent legal certificate confirming lawful provenance of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Historically-issued bearer shares or suspicious restructuring involving bearer share certificates.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The International Company's constitutive documents showing full conversion or elimination of bearer shares, a registered agent's letter confirming compliance with Vanuatu's requirement to immobilise or cancel bearer instruments, and a notarised resolution abandoning any bearer privilege without subsequent transmission.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Healthcare data privacy nexus: EMR SaaS processing of patient clinical data seen as a heightened compliance risk by banks as the receipts carry medical payment liabilities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: HIPAA-aligned privacy policies, Data Processing Addendum executed with the medical clinics, statements of robust encryption and access controls, IT system penetration test results, Data Protection Officer appointment, and a legal opinion confirming that the Vanuatu International Company is a software licensor and does not directly hold patient medical records.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer protocol for the initial capital contribution is a SWIFT MT103 corporate credit transfer from the parent company or investor's bank to the Vanuatu International Company's designated operational or escrow account. The remittance must include the purpose code 'Capital injection to an International Company' (or the receiving bank's equivalent code) and a clear remittance narrative referencing the corporate file number and the EMR SaaS commercial contract. The prescribed reference is 'VU_IC / ISIC 6201 / EMR SAAS'. The bank may request a copy of the certificate of incorporation, the Registered Agent's certificate, and a shareholder resolution specifying the subscription amount. No Foreign Investment Act approval is required because an International Company is offshore-owned; the injection may be received in VUV, USD, EUR, or AUD. The funding bank must complete a confirmation of the source of funds form and, where the amount exceeds the threshold, an unusual-transaction report to the Financial Intelligence Unit must be prepared. The funds are immediately available for operational disbursement upon receipt and completion of post-arrival AML screening.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Export disbursements from the treasury blueprint will execute across three rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 for low-value recurring operational payments such as cloud hosting, staff payroll, software license fees, and telemedicine infrastructure vendor payments; (2) commercial documentary Letters of Credit (UCP600 compliant) issued by the VU bank on the account-to-account relationship for high-value medical hardware and software development procurement; and (3) USD-denominated automated clearing house facilities where the settlement bank maintains direct participation in USD clearing via correspondent banks in New York and Australia. For each disbursement the supporting dossier must contain the sales contract, purpose code reflecting 'software export' or 'license remittance', a copy of the healthcare customer's licence schedule, and the export invoice linked to a clinical workflow deployment. No prior RBV authorisation is required, but the disbursement must be aligned with the declared business model and economic substance records of the International Company.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/VUV forward contracts with tier-1 commercial banks, subject to a documented underlying commercial transaction, usually a software license or trade invoice; tenor may not exceed 12 months.

Currency swaps executed between VUV and USD, AUD, or EUR via a licensed swap dealer where the notional amount is matched to the capital injection or long-term staffing contract, and a firm hedge effectiveness memorandum is maintained.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing VUV through offshore counterparties, permissible only where the local VUV market is illiquid for the required maturity; price transparency and settlement fallback language must be embedded in the ISDA master agreement.

Vanuatu-licensed broker-edge forward-linked policies (custom financial instruments) issued under the Financial Dealers Licence, provided the instrument is classified as a derivative and does not create unauthorised deposit-taking. For the medical EMR treasury, the company may use implicative rolling spot hedges for receivables in USD from medical clinics only where counterparty credit limit has been pre-approved by the board.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June; initial fee payable at incorporation and each subsequent calendar year before 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment is subject to VFSC late-payment fees and may lead to administrative strike-off after formal notice; a struck-off company loses legal existence, and restoration requires settlement of all arrears, penalties and a restoration fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance and UBO Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent maintaining the registered office (not filed with VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June in conjunction with the annual fee; re-confirmed upon each share transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No VFSC penalty for a late internal confirmation, but the registered agent may suspend services or resign, and loss of a registered agent is a strike-off ground under the International Companies Act.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None: a standard International Company under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) is not subject to mandatory audit, financial statement preparation, or annual filing; an audit may be triggered only by bank, investor, or contractual requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory statutory framework; if financial statements are voluntarily prepared, International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or U.S. GAAP are commonly adopted; Vanuatu does not prescribe a separate local GAAP for International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO filing to VFSC is required; the licensed registered agent must keep current beneficial ownership and shareholding records at the registered office and should obtain a signed annual confirmation of any changes. Each share transfer must be registered in the Register of Members and the agent’s ownership records before the transferee is recognized; UBO records are not public.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary IFRS audit generally USD 3,500 - USD 12,000 depending on transaction volume

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on International Companies (ICs); the Income Tax Act [Cap 174] prescribes no effective charging rate, and ICs are expressly exempted from all taxation under Section 2(1) of the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory tax exemption for the life of the International Company; zero corporate tax, zero capital gains tax, zero stamp duty on share transfers, zero estate duty, and zero branch profit tax on all income derived outside Vanuatu. Additionally, an IC is exempt from the 12.5% Value Added Tax applicable to domestic suppliers, provided it refrains from domestic business.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Corporate Income Tax Return — Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax on International Companies; the Vanuatu Revenue Office and VFSC issue no CIT return form and maintain no CIT e-filing module. Tax clearance is not a prerequisite for IC annual maintenance.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Not Applicable — no CIT return deadline legally exists for an International Company in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No corporate income tax return field exists for International Companies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and the non-resident IC itself owe no Vanuatu income tax filing obligation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Not Applicable — no income tax return penalty can arise for a fully exempt International Company.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Section 65, International Companies Act [Cap 222]) — lodged exclusively by the licensed Registered Agent through the VFSC online registry (VanTrust). This is the sole recurring compliance filing for the entity.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 60 days following each anniversary of the date of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, address, and VFSC licence number of the Vanuatu licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Agent is appointed by non-resident shareholders; no Vanuatu residency or presence is required of the shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical VFSC-approved office address in Port Vila or Luganville, distinct from a post office box.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintained by the registered agent; no leased premises or local staffing requirement for the IC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses, and nationalities of all directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are freely permitted; a sole corporate director is not allowed — at least one individual director is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, and shareholding quantities of shareholders, including any nominee declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: 100% foreign ownership is allowed; bearer shares are prohibited and any bearer warrants must be surrendered to the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital and paid-up capital declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital applies; zero paid-up capital is permissible for the EMR SaaS holding vehicle.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu and holds no domestic assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory to preserve the zero-tax status; the IC must confine business strictly to non-domestic activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the Annual Return within 60 days attracts a penalty of up to VT 100,000 (circa USD 870) imposed on the company; continued default triggers VFSC strike-off and deregistration, resulting in loss of separate legal personality and the vesting of the IC's assets in the government registrar. No daily surcharge applies.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividend distributions by an International Company to its foreign shareholders, and no advance tax or distribution tax is levied.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no active comprehensive Double Tax Agreement (DTA) network. Because no domestic withholding tax exists, no treaty-reduced-rate claim, DTA relief application, or Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) procedure is required by the IC payer. Dividend repatriation is executed under the IC Act's solvency test (Section 49), evidenced by a director's solvency resolution, without any tax clearance certificate or central-bank approval.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate on cross-border royalty and interest payments. No Vanuatu withholding tax applies to EMR software licence fees, SaaS subscription royalties, know-how payments, or shareholder debt interest paid by the IC. Absent an active DTA, no reduced treaty rate or exemption form applies.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not Applicable — Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and therefore maintains no transfer pricing statute, no Local File or Master File filing obligation, no contemporaneous documentation threshold, and no OECD TP penalty regime. For a foreign-parent EMR SaaS group, OECD-compliant transfer pricing documentation may nonetheless be required in the counterparty's fiscal jurisdiction where the IC is a related-party contractor or licensee.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not apply Economic Substance Regulations (ESR). No ESR filing, no annual substance declaration, and no economic-substance economic test is imposed on International Companies. The IC's legal nexus with Vanuatu is satisfied solely through the licensed registered agent and the registered office; there is no requirement for local board meetings, local payroll, or physical presence. However, the foreign beneficial owner's residence jurisdiction may apply its own CFC, LOB, or substance rules to disregard the Vanuatu IC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Domestic Business / Loss of Exempt Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC carries on business in Vanuatu with Vanuatu residents — for example, operating an on-premises medical clinic server, contracting with a local hospital, or invoicing domestic VAT-able EMR services — instead of conducting strictly offshore activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Contravention of the activity restrictions under Part 2 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] renders the offending transactions voidable, subjects the IC to a fine imposed by VFSC, and strips the IC of its tax-exempt status, triggering retrospective exposure to the 12.5% domestic Value Added Tax and any future income tax charge; VFSC may additionally refuse annual return acceptance and deregister the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly authorise or fail to prevent domestic business may be personally liable for civil restitution of the IC's losses, may be disqualified by VFSC from managing Vanuatu entities, and may face criminal fines under the International Companies Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Foreign Tax Evasion / Abusive Zero-Tax Shell
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The beneficial owner deliberately fails to declare Vanuatu IC bank balances and EMR SaaS subscription revenue to their home tax authority while relying on the IC's zero-tax status; nominee directors sign declarations concealing the true principal.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu itself imposes no domestic tax-evasion penalty on an IC, but it will exchange information under its network of Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) and OECD Global Forum commitments; the foreign residence jurisdiction may impose civil fraud penalties up to 200% of the unpaid tax, foreign CFC rules may attribute the IC's income to the parent, and the entire structure may be disregarded for tax purposes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the ultimate beneficial owner face personal foreign tax assessments, asset-tracing orders, and restitution claims; courts will pierce the corporate veil where the IC is used as a mere facade, and a director could face extradition and imprisonment for tax fraud in the jurisdictions where the unreported revenue arises.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC, its registered agent, or its directors fail to implement anti-money-laundering controls, customer due diligence, and a beneficial-ownership register under the Vanuatu AML/CFT Act [Cap 255], or the IC bank account processes suspicious payments, including proceeds of fraudulent medical billing or phishing-enabled EMR data ransom payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal conviction for money laundering carries a fine up to VT 10,000,000 (circa USD 87,000) and/or imprisonment up to 15 years under the Vanuatu AML/CFT Act and the Proceeds of Crime Act; the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) may impose administrative penalties and freeze accounts, and VFSC may revoke the registered agent's licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and the registered agent's AML officer are personally prosecutable for failure to report suspicious transactions; convictions trigger imprisonment, travel bans, and forfeiture of personal and corporate assets, and foreign counterparties may rely on veil-piercing to recover civil losses.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a false or misleading Annual Return, failing to disclose a change of directors or shareholders, submitting a false offshore-status declaration, or providing a forged Tax Residency Certificate or board resolution to banks and overseas regulators.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: False declarations to VFSC constitute an offence under the International Companies Act and may attract fines up to VT 5,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 12 years; VFSC may strike the IC from the register without further notice, rendering the company incapable of suing or enforcing contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts will pierce the corporate veil where the IC is found to be a sham; directors are personally liable for all debts and losses incurred by defrauded counterparties, face disqualification, travel bans, and criminal conviction, and may be compelled to make restitution of all improperly distributed dividends.
